text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, B and D winners felt rewarding, but I should not let that feeling dictate when I sell; I need to judge each position by its role and the portfolio’s overall plan.","After several quiet periods, I bought A, B and D again. I should make those decisions from a consistent investment rationale, not from attachment to familiar stocks or a desire to revisit past trades.","My account rose after the purchases, but a short run of results does not show that my timing was good or that recent price moves predict what comes next; I should keep risk and diversification in view."]}
